name: neurodevelopmental disorder with non-specific brain abnormalities and with or without seizures
description: An autosomal dominant disorder characterized by developmental delay, intellectual disability, seizures, autism spectrum disorder, behavioral abnormalities, and variable non-specific brain malformations.
